race.comment: SEGURO (5) is racing in good order, sitting up front but being reeled in last start at Albury, beaten 1.1L. Draws well again this time and back slightly in trip looks a big tick for him.  He was a winner over this trip when leading throughout three starts back, and he can get back to winning ways. IKON PARK (3) looks a very progressive type, showing plenty in a strong form race on debut before a 0.7L victory last time out at Albury. Out in trip looks to suit this son of Prized Icon and Loy sticking is a big tick. Will need some luck from the draw, but he can continue to rise through the grades. ALABAMA HUSSY (4) won well two back before a disappointing effort on soft going at Nowra most recently. Heywood rides now and the win two back stacks up in this field. Won't be far away. VANROSA (15) surprised last start but the figures line up well and she can show it wasn't a fluke. DEEKAYGEEBEE (1) can be thereabouts.
